title: eval-harness: add prompt-quality CI gate and eval metrics integration
author: Priya Nair
description: Introduce a prompt-quality CI gate that runs evaluation harness prompt-set checks as part of PR validation and exposes a pass/fail signal based on configurable thresholds. Motivation: prevent prompt-set regressions from landing (ENG-1452) and make quality diffs visible in CI. This change adds a new GitHub Actions job `eval-quality-gate` that runs a focused eval subset, uploads metrics to the CI artifact store, and fails the job when specified metrics regress beyond thresholds defined in eval/config/quality_gates.yaml. The PR also wires the eval metrics into the existing `ci-metrics` dashboard and includes an Opt-out label `ci/skip-eval-gate` for large infra churn. Checklist: - [x] Add GH Actions job and scripts - [x] Add quality_gates.yaml with sane defaults - [x] Integrate metrics uploader for CI artifacts - [x] Add docs snippet in docs/ci/quality-gates.md - [x] Update eval-harness README with how to run locally - [x] Tests: add smoke test for job runner in unit tests. Related: Linear ENG-1452, ENG-1599.
commits: a1b2c3d: add new GH Action job eval-quality-gate and scripts to run subset of evals
d4e5f6g: introduce eval/config/quality_gates.yaml and defaults for prompt-quality thresholds
h7i8j9k: implement metrics uploader to CI artifact store and unit tests

review_comments: Eliot Chen: Nice end-to-end shape. Please make the threshold file schema explicit and document what each metric means.
Priya Nair: Addressed: added schema and inline comments in eval/config/quality_gates.yaml and expanded docs with metric definitions.
Marco Diaz: The GH Action runs for full eval matrix will be expensive. Can we gate it to a reduced subset for PRs?
Priya Nair: We run a focused subset by default; added `eval/ci_subsets/reduced_prompts.yml` and updated the workflow to use the reduced subset for PRs and full subset for release branches.
Sasha Ivanov: Found a flake where transient network failures caused false negatives. Recommend retry/backoff in metrics uploader.
Priya Nair: Added retry logic with exponential backoff and a small jitter; added unit test to simulate transient failures.
discussion_summary: Initial CI run failed due to a flaky metrics uploader and an overly strict default threshold for the 'consistency' metric. Addressed by adding retries and loosening the default threshold; subsequent CI run passed. Reviewers approved after verifying docs and unit tests. Merged with squash.
merge_outcome: merged into main after approvals and successful CI; no conflicts
release_notes: Adds a CI-level prompt-quality gate that runs a reduced eval subset on PRs and fails when configured metrics regress. Includes documentation and a configuration file for threshold tuning.
notes_for_ops: Ops: the GH Action stores metrics as artifacts under <repo>/artifacts/eval-quality/<pr_number>/metrics.json; the metrics uploader uses the existing CI artifact store credentials. If you have strict retention, increase retention for eval artifacts to 14 days.
how_to_test_locally: Run `python -m pytest eval-harness/tests/test_quality_gate.py` and `python eval-harness/ci_runner.py --subset reduced_prompts` to simulate the CI job locally.
